slides.texte_overlay:
How to become the man
your family can count on
Answer when they call. Not always immediately, but always. Your family should never wonder if you'll pick up when something goes wrong.
Show up to the important days. Birthdays, graduations, hospital visits. Your presence on big days is remembered for years. Be that man.
Stay calm in a crisis. Someone has to make the calls, drive to the hospital, handle the paperwork. Be the steady one everyone looks to.
Take care of your own life. Health, money, mental state. You can only support others well when you're solid yourself. Your health is part of being there for them.
Before: I had little to say at family dinners. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and now I always have stories to share.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: I had little to say at family dinners. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Now I always have stories to share.

slides.texte_overlay: Learn practical skills. First aid, basic repairs, cooking for many. Being useful when it matters is how trust is built. Small skills, big trust.
Keep your word, even in small things. If you said you'd come on Sunday, come. Reliability in small promises builds trust for big ones.
